summary: A project skill that maps folder-level imports would help agents find their way around src/ and electron/, but the Python extractor and the shell alias don't fit this repo.
benefits: Agents read the FSD layer map instead of opening many files
Import rules (app → pages → … → shared) become visible to the agent
The map is rebuilt by an npm script, no new runtime

changes.label: Repo map skill
changes.why: A skill that tells agents to read the generated layer map first.
The project has no .claude/skills folder yet.
A `map` script rebuilds the import map.
One line pointing agents to the map.
Rebuilding on every commit would slow the Stop hook that already runs typecheck.

steps.title: Add a `map` npm script that writes the folder-level import graph to docs/map.json
Add a repo-map skill that reads docs/map.json before exploring
Point agents to the map in AGENTS.md

unfit.title: Python 3.11 + tree-sitter extractor
unfit.why: The repo is TypeScript only; a Python toolchain is a new dependency for every contributor.
